name: Sentry issues
description: Your Sentry issues in prifly: log in with your own Sentry token, start a session from an issue with its stack trace, breadcrumbs and the whole latest event on disk, and keep the issue on that session's banner.

settings.label: Start sessions by itself
settings.description: Each new open issue nobody works on becomes a Research session: it investigates and proposes, and changes nothing until you say Act.

settings.label: Levels
settings.description: The issue levels that start a session.

settings.label: Most per day
settings.description: prifly also holds it to 3 running at once and 12 an hour.

settings.label: Newest errors only (hours)
settings.description: Only issues last seen within this many hours start a session; older ones are left alone.

launch.label: From a Sentry issue…
launch.description: Your unresolved issues, newest or most frequent first, across every project of your organization, once you have logged in and chosen it: both happen here. Each session starts in the project's checkout, found through Sentry's code mappings. The session starts knowing the issue: counts, releases, tags, the latest event's stack trace, breadcrumbs and request.
